name: Omabump
author: vladkarok
description: Updates for your AI apps and coding-agent CLIs: see what is newer in Omarchy's repo, at the vendor or in mise, and update that one app.

barWidget.description: Shows when Omarchy's repo, a vendor or mise has a newer version of an installed AI app or coding-agent CLI, and updates that one app in a terminal when you press Update: from Omarchy's signed package, the vendor's Arch package or mise. Build now, once you turn it on, builds Omarchy's own recipe for a release its repo does not have yet.

schema.label: Notify on new releases
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when a newer version of an installed app is out.

schema.label: Show CLI tools
schema.description: List the agent CLIs installed as packages or by mise (Claude Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode...) after the desktop apps.

schema.label: Bar icon only when updates exist
schema.description: Show the bar icon only when an installable update exists, a vendor has a release Omarchy's repo does not have yet, or a check failed. IPC open and toggle still open the panel.

schema.label: Build now
schema.description: Offer Build now for an app whose vendor released a version Omarchy's repo does not have yet: it builds Omarchy's own recipe on this machine, takes minutes, and the package is not signed by Omarchy.
